senses.zh_definition: 谢尔登：英语男性名字，也用作姓氏及地名；具体指称须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English masculine given name, also used as a surname and place name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama lelaki, nama keluarga atau nama tempat, bergantung pada konteks.

etymology.historical_story: Sheldon belongs to the English tradition of surnames taken from places. Several English settlements bear this name, so its history does not reduce to one universal literal meaning. Different place-name analyses involve Old English words for a ledge, hill or valley. Its use as a given name continues the surname tradition. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=sheldon), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sheldon)
